abstract: A case report of testicular tumors in non-twin siblings is presented. A 42-year-old male was admitted to Kansai Electric Power Hospital with the complaint of swelling of the left scrotal contents. Left radical orchiectomy was performed with the diagnosis of a left testicular tumor. Histological examination revealed a seminoma of the left testis. Fifteen years later, his 43-year-old younger brother was admitted to Osaka University Hospital with the complaint of painless swelling of the left scrotal contents. Left radical orchiectomy was carried out with the diagnosis of a left testicular tumor. Histological examination showed a seminoma of the left testis. The former patient had a history of a scrotal trauma, but there was no history of orchitis or cryptorchism in these two siblings. To our knowledge, there have been reported 44 sets of testicular tumors in siblings. Eleven of these sets appeared in twins, while the other 33 sets were described in non-twin siblings. We discussed the 45 cases including our case of testicular tumors in siblings.
abstract_ja: 42歳の男性が、左精巣腫瘍の診断で、埼玉県の関西電力病院に入院した。陰嚢内容の腫脹を主訴としていた。左根治的精巣摘除術を施行した。組織学的検査で左精巣のセミノーマと診断された。15年後、43歳の弟が、無痛性の陰嚢内容の腫脹を主訴に大阪大学病院に入院した。左根治的精巣摘除術を行い、組織学的検査で左精巣のセミノーマであった。前者の患者には陰嚢外傷歴があったが、この兄弟には精巣炎や停留精巣の既往はなかった。我々の知る限り、兄弟における精巣腫瘍は44組が報告されており、そのうち11組は双生児、残りの33組は非双生児の兄弟であった。我々の症例を含む兄弟の精巣腫瘍45例について考察した。
